Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compared neurons recovered with propionic acid (PA) versus a control recovery group. While the study also investigates butyric acid (BA) and combined treatments in other assays (neurite outgrowth, luminescence), the MS analysis is explicitly described as a comparison between CTRL-Recovery and PA-Recovery. Mapping is kept at the parent level 'chemical_or_drug' as PA is a short-chain fatty acid acting as a ligand/metabolite, and while it inhibits HDACs, it is not a synthetic 'small-molecule inhibitor' in the traditional pharmacological sense of the fine-grained classes.
